citations.claim: EW approach 1 is yellow at step 96, start of truncated yellow
EW approach 1 still yellow at step 98, third second of yellow
EW approach 1 already red at step 99 after only 3s yellow, first violating step

counterfactual.change: Changed actuated true to false; fixed-time cycle lets yellow run full 5s so violation disappears.

explanation: With actuated=true and NS starved (N wait 73-76, S wait 80-83 at steps 96-99 with large queues), the controller's long-wait recall for NS truncates the active EW yellow: EW is green at step 95, yellow only at steps 96-98 (3s), then all-red before NS at step 99, violating the required 5s yellow. Disabling actuation removes the preemption and the failure disappears.
vision_note: The east-west approaches show yellow in steps 96-98 and then all four approaches are red at step 99, so the yellow lasts only three seconds. Long north-south vehicle queues are visible throughout while the active yellow is cut short to give all-red.
